operation.description:
Gets information about a suite of rule evaluations from within a repository.
For more information, see "[Managing rulesets for a repository](https://docs.github.com/repositories/configuring-branches-and-merges-in-your-repository/managing-rulesets/managing-rulesets-for-a-repository#viewing-insights-for-rulesets)."

rule_source.name: Author email must be a GitHub email address

rule_evaluations.details: Changes must be made through a pull request.

#/components/parameters/owner.description: The account owner of the repository. The name is not case sensitive.
#/components/parameters/owner.name: owner

#/components/parameters/repo.description: The name of the repository without the `.git` extension. The name is not case sensitive.
#/components/parameters/repo.name: repo

#/components/parameters/rule-suite-id.description:
The unique identifier of the rule suite result.
To get this ID, you can use [GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/rulesets/rule-suites](https://docs.github.com/rest/repos/rule-suites#list-repository-rule-suites)
for repositories and [GET /orgs/{org}/rulesets/rule-suites](https://docs.github.com/rest/orgs/rule-suites#list-organization-rule-suites)
for organizations.
#/components/parameters/rule-suite-id.name: rule_suite_id

actor_id.description: The number that identifies the user.

actor_name.description: The handle for the GitHub user account.

after_sha.description: The new commit SHA of the ref.

before_sha.description: The previous commit SHA of the ref.

evaluation_result.description: The result of the rule evaluations for rules with the `active` and `evaluate` enforcement statuses, demonstrating whether rules would pass or fail if all rules in the rule suite were `active`. Null if no rules with `evaluate` enforcement status were run.

id.description: The unique identifier of the rule insight.

ref.description: The ref name that the evaluation ran on.

repository_id.description: The ID of the repository associated with the rule evaluation.

repository_name.description: The name of the repository without the `.git` extension.

result.description: The result of the rule evaluations for rules with the `active` enforcement status.

details.description: The detailed failure message for the rule. Null if the rule passed.

enforcement.description: The enforcement level of this rule source.

result.description: The result of the evaluation of the individual rule.

id.description: The ID of the rule source.

name.description: The name of the rule source.
